description: This file defines the ExternalLoginsViewModel class used in the ASP.NET Core web project, representing the data model for managing external login providers in user account management.

classes.name: ExternalLoginsViewModel
classes.description: View model for managing external login providers in user account settings.

properties.name: CurrentLogins
properties.description: List of user’s current external login accounts.

properties.name: OtherLogins
properties.description: List of other available external login providers.

properties.name: ShowRemoveButton
properties.description: Flag indicating whether to show the remove button for external logins.

properties.name: StatusMessage
properties.description: Optional status message to display to the user.
